content.text: How many vacation days does a full-time employee get?
25 working days per calendar year, 28 days after 5 years of service.
How many unused vacation days can be carried over and until when?
Up to 5 days, to be used by 31 March of the next year.
When is a doctor's note required for sick leave?
From the 3rd consecutive sick day.
How long is parental leave for the primary caregiver?
20 weeks at full pay, available after 6 months of employment.
What is the hotel limit in San Francisco?
Up to $300 per night.
What is the daily meal per diem for international travel?
$95 per day; no receipts are needed for per diem.
Within how many days must expense claims be submitted?
Within 30 days in Expensify; claims older than 90 days are rejected.
How many office days per week are required?
At least 2 office days per week; Tuesday and Thursday are team days.
What is the home office allowance?
A one-time $1,000 in the first 6 months plus $50 per month for internet and phone.
What is the 401(k) company match?
4%: 100% of the first 4% of salary, immediately vested.
How large is the yearly learning budget?
$1,500 per year; manager approval is needed above $300.
How long is the probation period?
3 months, with check-ins at 30, 60 and 90 days.
